text.en:
1. This order may be cited as the Revision of Laws (Rectification of Criminal
Procedure Code) Order 2005.

Rectification

2. The reprint of the English language text of the Criminal Procedure Code
[Act 593] published in the year 2002 incorporating all amendments up to
31 January 2002 is rectified in section 154 by substituting for the words
"153 and 154" the words "152 and 153".

Made 25 May 2005
[P.N. (SU.2)I/rev/RO; PN(PU?)231/III]

DATIN ZALEHA BINTI YUSOF
Commissioner of Law Revision Malaysia

P.U. (A) 225.
